name: Seducing The Devil
source:
You play as Alan, a 22 year old English male. After being in a virtual relationship for 2 years, you have finally decided to meet your girlfriend Ella who lives in USA. You have to convince her family for you to take things further. Are they willing to accept you?

Also you have to make peace with your friend Selina and her mother Veronica. They so aren't happy with your decision to leave them for a while. But what your friend and her mother have anything to do with you meeting your girlfriend? Are you tangled in some kind of mess?

Will you come out of that mess? What path are you going to choose? How far are you willing to go?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/deafperv]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演艾伦，一名22岁的英国男性。经过两年的虚拟恋爱关系，你终于决定与住在美国的女友艾拉见面。你必须说服她的家人让你更进一步。他们愿意接受你吗？

此外，你还必须与你的朋友塞琳娜和她的母亲维罗妮卡和解。他们对你离开他们一段时间的决定很不满意。但是你的朋友和她的母亲和你遇见你的女朋友有什么关系呢？你是否陷入某种混乱之中？

你能走出困境吗？你会选择什么道路？你愿意走多远？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/deafperv]Patreon[/url]]
